result.summary: Found 2 visually noticeable issues: one major loading-state artifact and one minor layout truncation at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The featured ramen card shows a loading spinner sitting on top of the image, which makes the card look unfinished or stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image finishes loading before showing the card, or replace the spinner with a proper skeleton/loading placeholder that matches the design.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom is partially cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so its content is not fully visible on screen.
issues.suggestion: Add more bottom padding to the scroll area or account for the navigation bar height so content doesn't get hidden behind the tab bar.
